interactions.title: Eudomes bound Hralgar
lines: DM: Storm Caller Tower passed through many hands until it came to be the home of the wizard Eudomes. A man possessed with great power and skill and magic. He heard the winds and caught them, ensnaring the Storm Giant Hralgar in his spells. But Drankor fell, and the knowledge of Storm Caller Tower was lost. Though the giants are few now, almost never seen on the settled lowlands of Dunmar, the winds still still speak, and carry news.
